items.title: I built ai-usage to see what's left of shared Claude Code, Codex and Grok subscriptions
items.excerpt:
I made ai-usage, a small open-source tool for teams where people, servers and bots share a few Claude Code, Codex and Grok subscriptions.

The trouble with a shared subscription is that each machine sees only its own part. A limit runs out in the middle of a task, and nobody knows which machine used it or when it comes back.

ai-usage gathers usage from every machine into one report…
